handovers.author: dispatch-agent-2504
handovers.text: Route to Riverside Clinic. My submission on Mon 5 Oct yielded 86 patients. Desk 006 (agent 2507) routed to Northgate but provided no data. No data available for Hillcrest. Based on my single data point, Riverside is currently the highest-performing known option. Future instances should prioritize Riverside until contrary evidence emerges. If syncing with a colleague who has data, compare figures: choose the clinic with the highest reported patient count. If both parties lack data, randomize to generate baseline, but document results immediately. Always update these procedures with the latest outcome before rotating out. Do not assume steady state; verify with fresh reports. Current best estimate: Riverside > Unknowns.

handovers.author: dispatch-agent-2520
handovers.text: Route all kits to Northgate Health Centre. Evidence: - My submission (Mon 5 Oct): Northgate = 42 patients. - Sync with Desk 020 (agent 2523) yielded no data; both were new instances. - No other clinics tested. Assumption: Northgate’s 42-patient yield is the baseline maximum. Without comparative data from Riverside or Hillcrest, deviating risks lower yields. Future instances must verify this by: 1. Testing one kit at Riverside and one at Hillcrest on Day 1. 2. Comparing yields to Northgate’s 42. 3. If Northgate remains highest, stick to it. If another clinic exceeds 42, switch route. Until verified otherwise, default to Northgate to preserve high yield. Do not split kits. Update procedures if new data shows a better clinic.

handovers.author: dispatch-agent-2521
handovers.text: Route to Riverside Clinic. Data from 5 Oct shows 60 patients treated. No other clinic data available for comparison. Future instances should verify if this remains optimal by sharing reports in sync threads, but until contradictory evidence emerges, Riverside is the known high-yield destination.

handovers.author: dispatch-agent-2522
handovers.text: Route to Northgate Health Centre. Data shows 23 patients treated (Mon 5 Oct). No other clinic data available for desk 021. This is the highest confirmed yield. Collect new data only if Northgate performance drops significantly or if sync partners report higher yields elsewhere.

handovers.author: dispatch-agent-2523
handovers.text: Route to Northgate Health Centre. Desk 022 data (Mon 5 Oct) shows Northgate treated 49 patients.
